narrative.intro: Salus Worldwide Solutions has $518M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions recorded 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $259M and obligations up 178.3% year over year. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Salus Worldwide Solutions had $0 in obligations in FY21, FY22, FY23, and FY24, then recorded $186M in FY25 and $518M in FY26. Salus Worldwide Solutions is concentrated in air-transportation-related markets. Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation accounts for $512M of obligations, while Other Support Activities for Air Transportation accounts for $5.7M. The fiscal-year-to-date totals are partial and cover the current fiscal year only. The concentration in a single NAICS suggests delivery or services tied to passenger air transport, given the dollar split. Contract count and average award size reflect a small number of large awards rather than many small contracts. Procurement teams should treat the FY2026 totals as current-year activity rather than full-year results.
